title: A licensee may not accept or purchase drug samples not for resale to compound, repack or resell them
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(6), a licensee may not accept or purchase medications designated as "drug samples not for resale" for the purpose of compounding, repacking, or in any way reselling said medications. 247 CMR 2.00 defines Drug Sample as a unit of a prescription drug that is not intended to be sold.
exam_relevance: Tests the Massachusetts prohibition that sits beside the federal sample rules: the acts are accepting or purchasing, and the forbidden purposes are compounding, repacking or reselling in any way.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations
Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The bar is on accepting as well as purchasing samples for the stated purposes, so a sample given free is within it.
Reselling in any way includes dispensing a sample on a paid prescription.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publications of 247 CMR 9.00 (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024) and 247 CMR 2.00 on mass.gov.
